talk.desc: No stat. Moves the pair halfway to the next bond level.

BOND_MAX_PERK.desc: +10 aim (instead of +5) near the partner, and +10 will.

Temple-raised: {n} came to the Temple before they could walk. The Archives were their playground.
{n} was raised by the crèche masters and never knew another home. They are calm in a way that unsettles people.
{n} grew up in the Temple’s lower halls, fixing droids for the Guard. They still talk to machines.
Late found: {n} was found at nine, picking pockets in a spaceport. The Council argued for a week before taking them.
{n} lived on a farm until a Jedi noticed the crops never failed. They miss the rain.
{n} was found late, after a fire nobody else walked out of. They don’t talk about it.
Republic Army: {n} enlisted at seventeen to get off a mining world. Three tours later, they asked for Temple duty.
{n} comes from an army family. Their mother still writes, asking when they’ll come home.
{n} served on the Outer Rim pickets. They know what Sith raiders leave behind.
Temple Guard: {n} stood guard at the Temple doors for six years without seeing a fight. They volunteered for the field.
{n} is the first of their clan to wear the Guard’s mask. They take it off for no one.
{n} trained with the Guard but was never chosen for the inner halls. They mean to earn it.
Hired: {n} was a mercenary until a Jedi paid them in mercy instead of credits. They stayed.
{n} signed on for the pay. Nobody has asked them to leave, and they haven’t asked to.
{n} drifted in from the Hutt worlds with a good rifle and no references.

hints: {n} sends half their pay to a Mid Rim address every month.
{n} keeps a holo of two kids, face down, in their footlocker.
{n} told {p}: “My brother picked the wrong side.”
brother.reveal: {n}’s brother rides with Sith raiders. {n} wants him back, alive.
brother.ask: {n}’s brother was seen with a raider crew. {n} asks to go, and asks you not to shoot him.

hints: A Hutt courier asked for {n} by name at the Temple gate.
{n} flinches at the sound of Huttese.
{n} admitted to {p} that they owe more than they’ll ever earn.
debt.reveal: {n} owes a Hutt broker a fortune from their merc days. The broker has started collecting.
debt.ask: The broker holds a hostage against {n}’s debt. Free the hostage and the debt dies with the deal.

hints: {n} won’t talk about their first unit.
{n} wakes up shouting a village name.
{n} told {p}: “I ran once. Never again.”
deserter.reveal: {n} deserted a picket under fire years ago. The village it guarded burned.
deserter.ask: Raiders are back at the village {n} once abandoned. {n} wants to hold the line this time.

hints: {n} hums a tune nobody taught them.
{n} stops mid-step sometimes, listening.
{n} told {p} a crystal has been singing to them since childhood.
song.reveal: A kyber crystal has called to {n} all their life. Now they know where it is.
song.ask: {n} finally knows where the singing crystal lies, and so do the Sith.

hints: {n} meditates alone, at night, more than anyone.
{n}’s eyes went yellow for a heartbeat. Maybe a trick of the light.
{n} told {p} about a voice that promises them strength.
voice.reveal: A dark voice has whispered to {n} since an old shrine visit. It is getting louder.
voice.ask: {n} wants to face the voice at its source: the old shrine.

hints: {n} keeps a broken saber hilt that isn’t theirs.
{n} asks the Archives about one mission, over and over.
{n} told {p}: “My first master didn’t die the way the records say.”
master.reveal: {n}’s first master was betrayed, and their relics were sold to raiders.
master.ask: Raiders are selling {n}’s first master’s relics. {n} wants them back.

hints: {n} reads Old Sith script without trying.
{n} avoids the Archive wing on the Sith wars.
{n} told {p} their grandmother was a Sith Lord.
bloodline.reveal: {n} descends from a Sith family. They fear what that means.
bloodline.ask: A Sith shrine of {n}’s bloodline is waking. {n} must face it, or be claimed by it.

hints: {n} counts the exits in every room.
{n} keeps a list of names. It is long.
{n} told {p} they were the only one who walked out of their village.
survivor.reveal: {n} is the only survivor of a Sith raid on their home. They saw who led it.
survivor.ask: The raiders who burned {n}’s home are back in the same valley.

hints: {n} sends a message home every month. It always says the same thing.
{n} keeps a farmer’s token on their belt.
{n} told {p} about a promise to a dying man.
oath.reveal: {n} swore to protect a dying farmer’s village. They joined to keep that oath.
oath.ask: The village {n} swore to protect is under attack. An oath is an oath.

HINT_TRIGGERS.field: came back from a field op

allyDown: Get them out of the open!

kill: I got one! I got one!
hit: They shot me! They actually shot me!
allyDown: Oh no. Oh no, they’re down!

crit: The Force was with that one.

allyDown: Told you this was a bad idea. Medic!

panic: The calm… I can’t find it.
None of the texts said this.

kill: I’m sorry it came to this.

crit: I saw it before it came.
allyDown: Not them. Not like the vision.

DEEDS.why: went down twice and came back
